title: All I Want for Christmas Is You
headline: Why Mariah Carey's team hesitated over a Christmas album
caption:
"We're putting out a Christmas album. No big deal." That's how Walter Afanasieff, Carey's co-writer, described the plan in 2015.

The line is worth keeping because the stakes were meant to be that low. Christmas albums were typically released when artists' careers were waning, and Afanasieff said nobody was doing new, big Christmas songs then. Carey herself said that at Christmas people really want the standards, "no matter how good a new song is." She made writing a few new ones a priority anyway, and this was the third and last original they planned, meant as a Phil Spector, sixties-sounding Christmas song.

🎧 The song: "All I Want for Christmas Is You" by Mariah Carey (@mariahcarey)
